```artifact
Feature: Alarm Management for Pressure Monitoring

  Scenario: GUI logs onset and reset of low pressure alarm
    Given the system is monitoring inspiratory pressure
    When the inspiratory pressure falls below the low pressure threshold
    Then the GUI logs the onset of the low pressure alarm
    And when the inspiratory pressure rises above the low pressure threshold
    Then the GUI logs the reset of the low pressure alarm

  Scenario: Low pressure alarm triggers and resets automatically
    Given the inspiratory pressure is below the low pressure threshold
    When the system detects low inspiratory pressure
    Then the low pressure alarm is triggered with high priority
    And when the first breath with inspiration pressure above the threshold is detected
    Then the low pressure alarm is automatically reset

  Scenario Outline: Pressure high alarm activates and deactivates based on breath count
    Given the system is monitoring inspiratory pressure
    When the inspiratory pressure exceeds the specified threshold for <breath_count> consecutive breaths
    Then the pressure high alarm becomes active
    And when the inspiratory pressure does not exceed the specified threshold for one breath
    Then the pressure high alarm becomes inactive
    Examples:
      | breath_count |
      | 3            |
      | 4            |
      | 2            | # edge case: below threshold

  Scenario: GUI emits sound when pressure high alarm is active
    Given the pressure high alarm is active
    When the system detects the alarm state
    Then the GUI emits a sound

  Scenario: Pressure high alarm remains displayed until cancelled
    Given the pressure high alarm is active
    When the inspiratory pressure does not exceed the specified threshold for one breath
    Then the pressure high alarm becomes inactive
    And the pressure high alarm remains displayed

  Scenario: Alarm management supports visible but not audible alarm state
    Given the system is in alarm management mode
    When the user sets the alarm to visible but not audible
    Then the alarm is visible but no sound is emitted

  Scenario: PIP too high alarm has high priority
    Given the inspiratory pressure exceeds the PIP too high threshold
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the PIP too high alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Default value for PIP too high alarm is calculated correctly
    Given the commanded PIP value is <commanded_pip>
    When the system calculates the default PIP too high threshold
    Then the default PIP too high threshold is <commanded_pip> + 5cm H2O
    Examples:
      | commanded_pip | commanded_pip + 5cm H2O |
      | 10            | 15                    |
      | 20            | 25                    |
      | 0             | 5                     | # edge case: zero value
```
